title: PIXL 8000 Cherry Pop Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Pop is a rich, confectionery-inspired blend from PIXL 8000 that combines sweet Cherry with creamy Vanilla and a subtle trace of Almond. The result is a layered vape with dessert-like warmth and sweetness. Prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and accompanied by a 10ml refill reservoir, this pod supports up to 8000 puffs with the PIXL 8000 device. Mesh coil technology ensures consistent flavour and vapour. Compatible exclusively with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Kit, this pod is ideal for MTL vapers looking for something sweet, smooth, and comforting. Cherry Pop is one of the more indulgent options in the PIXL lineup.
